about_the_game:
COLD BANANA!

Brace yourself for a frosty, fast-paced treasure hunt where snow-covered bananas are the ultimate prize! In this chilly, tile-based adventure, players navigate through an icy grid, uncovering hidden banana treasures buried beneath the snow. But beware! The snowdrifts conceal sneaky traps, slippery hazards, and icy surprises that could derail your quest. Strategy, a sharp memory, and a little bit of luck will help you survive the frozen landscape. Are you ready to brave the blizzard and go bananas? 🍌❄️

Frozen Bounty is a single-player DLC of Banana Loco where you’ll hunt for frozen banana treasures hidden within icy tiles. Use snow-powered power-ups to navigate the frosty maze and outsmart traps. With a mix of strategy, tile memorization, and quick thinking, you’ll climb your way to high scores. Each level offers a new, challenging quest to find multiple banana treasures hidden beneath the snow. Will you uncover them all and become the ultimate frozen treasure hunter?

FEATURES

The game includes a treasure hunt within a set of tiles. Use power-ups to gain an advantage. Use them wisely because they're limited. Play a different mode where you will match same tiles to uncover secrets. Achieve high scores by collecting many banana treasures!

  • Tile Exploration: Players reveal tiles on the map to uncover treasures or hidden surprises.

  • Modes: Play a different mode where you match color tiles to uncover secrets

  • Cold Banana: Collect frozen treasures to win the round.

  • Card Power-ups: Power-ups return for your advantage to easily find the treasures.

  • Traps: Watch out for traps among cold tiles that can hinder your progress.

  • Medals: Earn medals by achieving certain high scores.
